## 更新内容

- 预览窗口改为直连像素 surface 渲染，取消隐藏 `Image` 和额外采样路径，整数倍率与 DPI 下更贴近原始画面。
- 预览刷新链路与视图模型状态进一步收敛，移除重复判断与镜像状态，减少不必要的刷新开销。
- 裁切、缩放和输出切换的稳定性继续加强，修正预览控件交互中的边界行为。

## Update Notes

- Preview rendering now uses a direct pixel surface, removing the hidden `Image` and extra sampling path so integer scaling and DPI behavior stay closer to the source.
- The preview refresh flow and view-model state were tightened to remove duplicate checks and mirrored state, reducing unnecessary work.
- Crop, zoom, and output switching received additional stability fixes around preview controls and edge cases.
